backlog.title: Unify the host rules.toml schema (C8)
backlog.description: One focused refactor: collapse the split [[layer_rules]]/[[callback_rules]] model into a single [[rule]] array, port evaluate() to one-pass semantics, enforce the new parse-time validity, update all callers, and sync the user-facing docs. The wire contract (ApplyHostContext), handshake, qmk-notifier crate, and qmk_notifier firmware are UNTOUCHED — C8 is host-side file format only. D2 (C11 0xFF rejection), D3 (C13 no-match clear_board:false), and D4 ('Edit rules' tray) are ALREADY in code and generate no tasks. See plan/004_f48a103bcb32/architecture/system_context.md for validated findings.

milestones.title: Unify the [[rule]] schema in code and docs
milestones.description: Merge LayerRule+CallbackRule into one Rule, change RuleSet to rules:Vec<Rule>, rewrite evaluate() as a single pass, enforce parse-time validity (>=1 of layer/enable/disable; layer!=255), update every caller (notifier.rs, main.rs, mod.rs render_rules_body, pattern.rs), fix the test suite, and sync the user-facing docs + regenerate llms_full.txt.

tasks.title: Port the rules model + evaluator to the unified [[rule]] array and update all code callers
tasks.description: Merge LayerRule+CallbackRule into one Rule, change RuleSet to rules:Vec<Rule>, rewrite evaluate() as one pass over the unified array, enforce parse-time validity, then fix every caller site that referenced the split arrays so the crate compiles and cargo test passes. The observable output of evaluate() (HostContext) is UNCHANGED for any input expressible in the old schema.

subtasks.title: Unify the data model, evaluator, and parse-time validity in src/core/rules.rs
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Validated against the live codebase — see plan/004_f48a103bcb32/architecture/system_context.md. The split model lives at src/core/rules.rs:70-171 (RuleSet @70 with layer_rules:Vec<LayerRule> rename="layer_rules" @76 + callback_rules:Vec<CallbackRule> rename="callback_rules" @80; LayerRule @126 with REQUIRED layer:u8; CallbackRule @165). evaluate() @410-493 does TWO scans: stage-1 'for rule in &rules.layer_rules' (first-match-wins, breaks @429) and stage-2 'for rule in &rules.callback_rules' (all-match @444). validate_layers @253 iterates rules.layer_rules rejecting layer==0xFF. contradictory_callback_names @314-316 iterates rules.callback_rules. The STALE doc-comment at rules.rs:393-394 says clear_board is '[host].disable_firmware_config' on no-match but the code already returns clear_board:false (C13) — fix the comment. Inline doc-comment TOML examples at rules.rs:46-63,117-130,146-159 still show layer=224/225; spec uses 10/11. The target spec is spec/HOST_RULES.md §9 (lines 485-502: the unified Rust model) and §8(3) (lines 370-376: one-pass semantics) — ALREADY at target wording. CRITICAL: the serde rename is rename="rule" (SINGULAR) so the TOML key is [[rule]] NOT [[rules]].
2. INPUT: src/core/rules.rs (the structs @70-171, evaluate @410-493, validate_layers @253, contradictory_callback_names @314-316, effective_disable_firmware_config @230 [unchanged], pattern_is_empty_core @325 [unchanged], doc-comments @33-159,209,235,307,346,349-408). src/core/pattern.rs (Pattern enum — UNCHANGED, imported as-is). spec/HOST_RULES.md §9 (source of truth) + §8(3).
3. LOGIC:
   - Replace LayerRule + CallbackRule with a SINGLE 'pub struct Rule' EXACTLY as spec §9 (lines 497-505): #[serde(rename="match")] pattern:Pattern; #[serde(default)] layer:Option<u8> (None => sets no layer); #[serde(default)] enable:Vec<String>; #[serde(default)] disable:Vec<String>; #[serde(default)] case_sensitive:bool; #[serde(default)] disable_firmware_config:Option<bool>. Delete LayerRule and CallbackRule entirely.
   - RuleSet: replace the two Vecs with '#[serde(default, rename="rule")] pub rules:Vec<Rule>'. Keep host:HostDefaults (unchanged). Keep #[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Default)].
   - Rewrite evaluate() to ONE pass over rules.rules (spec §8(3) line 370): for each rule where match_pattern(&rule.pattern, app_class, title, rule.case_sensitive) succeeds — push its effective_disable_firmware_config(rule.disable_firmware_config, host_default) to matched_effective; if rule.layer.is_some() && layer.is_none() set layer=rule.layer (FIRST-match-wins, exclusive — one host layer); accumulate enable names into the 'enabled' BTreeSet<u8> (via name_to_id, unknown skipped) and disable names into the 'disabled' BTreeSet<u8>. AFTER the loop: desired = enabled.difference(&disabled).copied().collect() (UNCHANGED two-set difference so disable is order-independent — preserves the fix guarded by test_evaluate_disable_before_enable_still_excludes). PRESERVE the no-match short-circuit VERBATIM: if matched_effective.is_empty() return HostContext { layer:None, callback_ids:vec![], clear_board:false, any_match:false } (C13 — do NOT change this to the global default). Then clear_board = matched_effective.iter().all(|&f|f) || !board_has_rules.
   - Rename validate_layers -> validate_rules. Iterate rules.rules. For each rule: reject layer==Some(0xFF) with the same Box<dyn Error> message (update prose to reference [[rule]]). ADD the new validity check: if rule.layer.is_none() && rule.enable.is_empty() && rule.disable.is_empty() return Err("invalid rule: must set at least one of layer/enable/disable (in addition to match). See spec/HOST_RULES.md §9 Validity"). Keep the 0xFF check as rule.layer==Some(255).
   - Update contradictory_callback_names (@314): iterate rules.rules instead of rules.callback_rules (per-rule enable∩disable contradiction; body unchanged).
   - Rewrite the evaluate()/HostContext doc-comment (rules.rs ~349-408): change 'Three-stage evaluation' stage-1/2 to describe the SINGLE pass over [[rule]] (layer first-match-wins inline + enable/disable all-match inline). FIX the stale no-match line @393-394 to say clear_board:false (C13), matching the actual code.
   - Update inline doc-comment TOML examples (rules.rs:46-63,115-130,146-159,209): change [[layer_rules]]/[[callback_rules]] -> [[rule]]; change layer=224/225 -> layer=10/11 (cosmetic C11 consistency with spec §9).
4. OUTPUT: Updated src/core/rules.rs with the unified Rule/RuleSet, one-pass evaluate(), and validate_rules. evaluate()'s observable HostContext output is byte-for-byte identical for any input expressible in the old schema. NOTE: the crate will NOT compile after this subtask alone (external callers in notifier.rs/main.rs/mod.rs still reference the old struct) — compilation is restored by S3. This subtask is the atomic unit (struct + evaluator + validity + internal callers must change together in one file).
5. DOCS: Mode A — the code doc-comments (the 'Three-stage evaluation' comment, struct-level TOML examples, the stale no-match line) are updated as part of this work (step 3). spec/HOST_RULES.md is already correct — no edit. User-facing docs/*.md are handled in P1.M1.T2.

subtasks.title: Rewrite the schema in docs/{configuration,examples,qmk-integration,troubleshooting}.md

Key semantic deltas every edit must capture: (a) two table-arrays collapse to ONE [[rule]]; (b) layer is now OPTIONAL (was required in [[layer_rules]]); (c) a rule must set >=1 of layer/enable/disable (else parse error); (d) layer is a raw QMK index (C11 — no reserved floor, only !=255); (e) TOML key is [[rule]] SINGULAR (rename="rule").

Add the validity note: a rule must set >=1 of layer/enable/disable. Keep the existing C11 wording (raw index, layer_state_t width).
